input.sha256_scope: No image input. Every case is span boxes and texts written out in the capture tool; the expected file is both the input record and the expected record.

upstream.capture_method: Real LayoutBlock objects were constructed and update_text_content executed over fourteen span corpora: English and CJK paragraphs, multi-span lines, hyphenation, indent-gap continuation, the reference coordinate override, both delimiter labels, vertical blocks including the tall-line filter, and the empty and single-line edge cases. Every span is text-labelled, so the formula re-recognition branch is never reached and no model runs.

limitations: Text-labelled spans only: the formula-span re-splitting path (split_boxes_by_projection plus a recognition-model call) belongs to the formula sub-pipeline, which is artifact-blocked, and is deliberately absent rather than stubbed.
A single-line block never sets seg_end (upstream's elif), and an empty block keeps its constructed num_of_lines of 1; both quirks are pinned, not repaired.
is_numeric approximates Python's Unicode \d with char::is_numeric, which additionally accepts Nl/No characters; no recorded case reaches the difference.
No model is run and no page is decoded.
